pr.title: fix(ui): keep sub-navigation labels on one line
pr.author: Claudius-Maginificent

llm.problem: The PR reports that sub-navigation labels can wrap mid-word after a narrow window episode, leaving panels narrow even after restarting. The changed nav_button explicitly selects TextWrapMode::Extend in src/ui/components/subscreen_chooser_panel.rs:43.
llm.why_needed: Tokens, Tools and DashPay share this button through add_subscreen_chooser_panel, so the shared component controls label wrapping across these menus. Recovery from persisted narrow panel state is claimed by the author; restart behavior was not checked.
llm.what_it_gives: A shared single-line label policy and a regression test that resizes the window, navigates between token screens, and checks button heights and consistent panel widths. The test code was read but not run.

fit_questions.question: Is the author's stated narrow-window tradeoff—clipping labels and preventing DashPay's resizable chooser from shrinking below its longest label—the intended navigation policy across all three menus?

llm.title: Prevent subscreen navigation labels from wrapping

introduction.problem_before: The reported trigger is a narrow chooser panel: navigation labels could wrap mid-word and keep the panel narrow. Previously, nav_button did not specify a wrap mode.
introduction.change: Set TextWrapMode::Extend in the shared button builder so navigation labels remain on one line.
introduction.example_before_after: A label such as "Token Creator" could previously split across lines; the changed button requests a single-line layout even when available width is narrow.

llm.title: Render the shared subscreen chooser
llm.called_by: The Tokens, Tools and DashPay chooser wrappers supply navigation items and panel options.
llm.decides: Creates the left panel with the caller's identifier and resizability setting, then builds a navigation button for each item.
llm.next: Calls nav_button with the item's label, active state and current theme.
llm.why: This shared entry point propagates the button layout change to all chooser callers.

llm.title: Prevent navigation labels from wrapping
llm.called_by: add_subscreen_chooser_panel constructs this button for each navigation item.
llm.decides: Explicitly selects TextWrapMode::Extend for both active and inactive buttons.
llm.next: Returns the configured button to ui.add in the shared renderer.
llm.why: Keeping labels on one line prevents wrapping from reducing their horizontal layout requirement.

assessment.headline: Navigation labels stay on one line across Tokens, Tools and DashPay.
assessment.reason: The change is confined to shared navigation layout. Its noticeable effects concern label readability and the horizontal space available to adjacent content; navigation actions remain unchanged.
assessment.basis_note: Read the base and head button builders, shared renderer, chooser callers and token regression test. Nothing was executed.
assessment.not_checked: Actual rendering at narrow widths, DashPay panel dragging, and recovery after reloading persisted panel state.

impact.reason: Supplies the token navigation labels to the shared renderer with resizing and scrolling disabled.
Uses the same button builder through a vertically scrollable chooser with resizing disabled.
Uses the same button builder in a resizable chooser, so the wrapping policy also applies during panel resizing.

llm.title: Return the clicked navigation action
llm.called_by: The shared renderer receives the response from ui.add.
llm.decides: Copies the item's action when clicked. The caller's scrollable option selects a vertical scroll area or a vertical layout.
llm.next: Renders remaining items, then returns the selected action or AppAction::None.
llm.why: Connects the changed visual layout to the existing navigation result.
